Shrey Diack is a soldier of the UFS.


Personality
Though she believes in the mission, she seems to hesitate to attack demon's that didn't do anything wrong. She questions authority, is upfront, talkative and upbeat. She can be a bit daring and competitive, which can bring her into trouble.

Furthermore, she doubts the righteousness of the UFS. Shrey says that she is not a mindless machine, that blindly and faithfully follows orders without question. As the youngest child in a large family of fishermen, she is cheerful and active, and values the bonds with her friends. However, she does not trust her unit, saying that they only work under orders and kill demons regardless of whether they are good or bad. She is open about her sexuality, perhaps because of her family background, but she does not have a lot of experience.

Appearance
She has short pink hair and yellow eyes.

History
Background
Shrey is a Human, a former UFS solder.

She is a member of the UFS Navy's Anti-Monster Special Forces. The youngest daughter of a family of fishermen, she has grown up by the sea since childhood. Although she wanted to help out in the family business, she had many older brothers and sisters, so she decided to support her family by doing something else and joined the military. She was not trained as an officer, and was supposed to end up as a single soldier. However, she discovered that she was actually from a family that hunted demons in the sea while working as a fisherman, and was assigned to an anti-demon unit. She now hunts many demons using her special armament, which is based on a familiar story, and her physical abilities, which have been unconsciously trained since she was a child. However, she also believes that, aside from the ferocious demons that come from the demon world, some demons that have taken root in the land are like a part of nature should not be defeated.

Timeline TABA
Appears in "What If" events. In the first heard rumors of a demonic beast near a harbor, the Fuuma Organization operated in. As she saw Fuuma Kotaro (TABA), she tried to bind him with her wire, to get him out of the way but was captured instead. Kotaro also investigated the situation and it was a pure chance encounter. In the end, she joins the Fuuma Organization after Kotaro's treatment. A follow-up event shows how Shrey now works for the group, having returned from a long-term mission. She tells Kotaro to visit her room for some fun, already wearing some rope bondage over her clothes. Though Kotaro didn't mind, he was sometimes also overwhelmed by her.


Powers/Abilities

Special Gear: Shoots a harpoon on a wire, binds targets.
